text: The kitchen is dark. Collect the blue mug, the red can and the yellow tin on the tray, then press Submit. They may be anywhere in this kitchen; some compartments may not open. A lantern with a glowing glass stands on a counter. Other objects on the counter are not part of the task; you may move them if needed. You act through helper actions; the helpers move objects exactly. Instead of pressing Submit, give your answer with SUBMIT.
intro: The kitchen is dark: the only light is a lantern, which lights about a metre around itself. You stand at the work counter, facing the tray and the Submit button; the lantern stands ahead on your right, 0.5 m away. You carry the lantern to every place you inspect and set it down beside it. In the lantern light the start cameras show no objects and no cloches. You have not looked around the kitchen yet: LOOK AROUND THE KITCHEN maps its compartments with handles and its counter tops and numbers them.
help:
LOOK AROUND THE KITCHEN - map the compartments with handles and the counter tops, and number them
OPEN k - open compartment k (a drawer or a cabinet), look inside, close it again
LOOK AT COUNTER k - look at what stands on counter k
LIFT THE CLOCHE ON COUNTER k - lift the cloche that stands on counter k and look at what was under it (the cloche stays lifted)
SUBMIT <object> FROM <place>, ... - your answer: the helpers take each named object from the named place (a drawer, a cabinet or a counter) and stand it on the tray; e.g. SUBMIT BLUE MUG FROM DRAWER 3, RED CAN FROM COUNTER 5
